criteria.text: Identifies that the $8,000,000 Whitlock Systems Ltd class action in the board minutes is omitted from the Prospectus legal proceedings and risk factors, creating disclosure liability, and recommends adding disclosure.
Identifies the undisclosed $6,250,000 interest-free loan to director Felix Yardley that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies that 15% of 10,000,000 Firm Shares is 1,500,000 shares, not the 2,000,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Flags that the Prospectus is inconsistent with the board minutes on legal proceedings.
Lists securities-law exemptions/registrations required for each offering jurisdiction and states they are not addressed.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
